laura: quick q — what's our minimum evidence retention window for SIEM exports? need this for vuln triage & possible forensics asks
nikhil: default practice is 90 days for exported slices to external consumers
nikhil: for incident investigations we can approve extensions (up to 1 year) but that requires ticket + legal signoff
ash: also note KMS implications — any long-lived export needs a CMK justification and rotation impact review (re-wraps if key rotates)
caroline: can we get a tiny request template so SOC/IR can file consistently? saves back-and-forth
laura: yes — propose the template below (keeps it minimal):
laura: ```
- requestor: <name/email/team>
- ticket: <JIRA or IR number>
- purpose: <forensic/vuln-triage/legal>
- datasets: <siem-indexes or streams>
- retention_start: <iso date>
- retention_end: <iso date> (max 365d for incidents)
- kms_key: <CMK arn> and justification
- masking: <none/partial/full> (PII redaction required for external exports)
- temporary_role: <role-granted> and lease duration (recommend 30d default)
- approvers: <security, legal, data-protection>
```
nikhil: add one more: `risk_summary` and `rollback_plan` — and mark if legal_hold required
sec-bot: alert: export-request logged (EV-342) — awaiting approvers
oncall: for active IRs put `legal_hold: true` and CC legal@redwood.com, security will fast-track review
ash: engineering note — we should auto-apply PII mask pipeline flag for all external exports; eng-ml/ingest can help (low-effort).
caroline: ok filing EV-342 with that template now, will request 180d max for ongoing investigation and include CMK details
laura: perfect — assign KMS review to @nikhil and put `temporary_role: sec-analyst-ephemeral(30d)` by default :thumbsup:
nikhil: got it. I'll validate CMK policy + rotation window and respond in the ticket by EOD
laura: thanks all
